name: Poonam Sood

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Poonam Chawla Sood writes poetry in Hindi and English and works as a translator. She founded Gulzar Sahitya Samiti in 1998. Her publications include the Hindi collection Misfit Kavitayien and Soulmates, her English translation of Dr. Bhavan Mahajan’s Marathi book Mitr Jeevache. Her poems have appeared in Lapis Lazuli and Different Truths.

In “मिसफिट”, a red plastic soap dish bought by a grandfather at a fair survives every change in its owner’s bathing habits. Surrounded by expensive shower gels, the old object becomes an image of someone who cannot quite fit into a social gathering. The everyday humour carries an affectionate attachment to the past and a sharper feeling of isolation.
